en.topic_title: Hong Kong court acquits woman over possessing laser pointers in 2019

zh.topic_title: Hong Kong court acquits woman over possessing laser pointers in 2019

en.topic_title: Hong Kong court acquits woman over possessing laser pointers in 2019
en.topic_summary:
A Hong Kong court has acquitted a woman of possessing a weapon when protests were taking place in a neighbouring district in 2019, after she was re-arrested upon returning to the city from Australia earlier this year.



Ami Chan was found not guilty of both charges of possessing an offensive weapon and possessing an item with intent to destroy or damage property at the Eastern Magistrates’ Courts on Thursday.



Eastern Magistrates’ Courts. Photo: Kelly Ho/HKFP.



Magistrate Edward Wong
